fields.System.Title: TRF-303 — Partial receipt of a transfer
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk at the destination, I want to book in part of a transfer, so that
stock that arrived on the first lorry is usable while the rest is still coming.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a partial receipt, then the received quantity moves out of VIRT-INTRANSIT and
  • the outstanding quantity stays in transit.
  • - Given a partly received transfer, then its status is partly received, distinct from
  • both open and closed.
  • - Given subsequent receipts, then they reduce the outstanding quantity until it reaches
  • zero.
  • - Given outstanding quantity past the expected transit time, then it is aged by
  • [TRF-402](TRF-402-age-and-escalate-overdue.md).
  • - Given all receipts together, then their total can never exceed what was dispatched.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, inventory |
| Tables | transfer_receipt, stock_balance |
| Risks | Outstanding balance lost rather than left in transit ([doc 05 WF 12](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant |
